validity.population: synthetic homogeneous cells with 40 independent identical receptors each
validity.physiological_state: software verification only; no physiological state
validity.description: Finite-count receptor binding noise and threshold classification under two prescribed constant ligand reservoirs.

sources.citation: Wendt, Regine (2024), Einsatz von Nanotechnologien in der Praezisionsmedizin, Sections 4.4-4.5, pp. 129-132
sources.role: cell reaction and stochastic population vision

sources.role: mass-action kinetics and exact occupancy moments

sources.citation: MEHLISSA Next ADR-0037 stochastic receptor binding
sources.role: SSA, random stream, population and classifier contract

limitations: All parameter values and both cohorts are synthetic software-test inputs.
The external ligand reservoir is homogeneous, prescribed, and not depleted.
Receptors are identical and independent; cells differ only through reaction noise.
The two cohorts are not clinical cases and rates are not diagnostic performance estimates.
There is no receptor turnover, competition, spatial transport, or intracellular network.
Threshold crossing is retained as a software event even when occupancy later falls.
Exact cross-platform equality is guaranteed only by the checked MEHLISSA random-stream implementation and algorithm version.
